text:
Plan: fluid = interior air box (160×100×40 mm) + a 3 mm-long vent duct through one short wall, minus the four standoff solids (Ø10×25 with Ø4×12 blind holes from the top, so the hole air stays in the fluid). All in metres. Patches classified by exact face geometry (plane/cylinder + radius), not bounding-box guessing.

```python
import os, subprocess
from build123d import *

# --- parameters (metres) ---
LX, LY, LZ = 0.160, 0.100, 0.040      # internal box
TW = 0.003                             # wall thickness
SD, SH = 0.010, 0.025                  # standoff dia, height
HD, HDP = 0.004, 0.012                 # blind hole dia, depth (from standoff top)
INSET = 0.015                          # standoff centre inset from each corner
VW, VH, VZ = 0.030, 0.020, 0.010       # vent width(y), height(z), bottom above floor

air = Pos(LX/2, LY/2, LZ/2) * Box(LX, LY, LZ)
duct = Pos(-TW/2, LY/2, VZ + VH/2) * Box(TW, VW, VH)
fluid = air + duct

for cx in (INSET, LX - INSET):
    for cy in (INSET, LY - INSET):
        post = Pos(cx, cy, SH/2) * Cylinder(SD/2, SH)
        hole = Pos(cx, cy, SH - HDP/2) * Cylinder(HD/2, HDP)
        fluid = fluid - (post - hole)

print(fluid.volume, len(fluid.faces()), fluid.bounding_box())
```
Volume checks out (6.4e-4 + duct 1.8e-6 − 4 posts 7.25e-6 = 6.3455e-4). Now classify faces by exact geometry into the six patch groups.
All six areas match analytic values. Export one STL per patch with a fine tessellation tolerance (the Ø4 mm holes need it).
Geometry looks right. Now the case: blockMesh background aligned to the box planes (5 mm base cells), then snappy with feature edges.
Meshed. Check patch areas against the analytic surface areas and run checkMesh.
Mesh OK. Now the final pass: `top`/`vent` should be `patch` type, not wall, and the Ø4 blind holes deserve one more level (0.31 mm ≈ 13 cells across).
The dict is fine — snappy was re-run on the already-snapped mesh. Rerun blockMesh first.
56.9k cells, Mesh OK. Now verify the meshed patch areas against the analytic values (this is the real check that the patches landed on the right surfaces).
All patches within 0.2% of analytic. Final dimensional check from the meshed surfaces themselves, plus a picture of the cut mesh.

Mesh is complete and verified.

**What I built:** the air volume inside the open-topped enclosure — 160×100×40 mm internal box, plus the 3 mm-long duct through the short wall at the vent, minus four Ø10×25 mm standoffs at 15 mm inset from each corner, each retaining its Ø4×12 mm blind hole air column open at the standoff top. Everything authored in metres (bbox −0.003…0.160 × 0…0.100 × 0…0.040 m).

**Patches** (each exported to its own STL in `constant/triSurface` before meshing, named on the face at selection by exact face geometry — plane position / cylinder radius, never bounding box): `top` (patch), `vent` (patch), `walls`, `floor`, `standoffs`, `holes` (walls).

**Measured vs requested**, from the meshed patches:

| quantity | mesh | requested |
|---|---|---|
| top area | 0.016000 m² | 0.160×0.100 |
| vent area | 0.000600 m² | 0.030×0.020, z 0.010–0.030 |
| floor area | 0.015687 m² | box − 4×Ø10 footprints |
| standoff radius (all 4) | 0.00500 m | 5 mm |
| standoff height | 0…0.0250 m | 25 mm |
| blind hole z-range / depth | 0.0130–0.0250 / 0.0120 m | 12 mm from top |
| standoff / hole areas | −0.19% / −0.16% of analytic | faceting only |
| fluid volume | 6.3474e-4 m³ | CAD 6.3455e-4 (+0.03%) |

**Mesh:** blockMesh 5 mm background aligned to the box planes, snappyHexMesh with feature snapping; 56 876 cells, level 4 (0.31 mm, ~13 cells across) inside the blind holes, level 3 on standoff surfaces. `checkMesh -allTopology`: **Mesh OK**, no errors.

**Not checked:** no layers were added (addLayers false), so there is no near-wall prism resolution; and I did not assess mesh independence — this is a geometry-faithful base mesh.
